title: Pretraining LLMs at Scale: Tuning Strategies and Performance Portability
problem: Large-scale LLM pretraining requires careful co-design of software, hardware, and parallelization strategies. Default configurations are suboptimal; performance portability across different systems unclear.
motivation: LLM training performance varies significantly based on configuration (ZeRO stages, communication collectives, batch size). Systematic tuning methodology needed for enterprise-scale deployment.
method: Communication-aware tuning methodology for LLM pretraining. Adapts performance portability metric to evaluate training efficiency across systems. Validated on production LLM training at enterprise scale with DeepSpeed.
key_novelty: Communication-aware tuning methodology for LLM pretraining; performance portability metric adaptation for training; systematic study challenging prevailing assumptions; 1.6x speedup over defaults.
contributions: Communication-aware tuning methodology for LLM pretraining
Performance portability metric adapted for LLM training evaluation
Six key insights: ZeRO stages trade-offs, communication collectives, batch size criticality
limitations: Enterprise-specific results; specific LLM size/architecture not detailed; generalization to other frameworks (FSDP, megatron-lm) unclear; abstract lacks specific tuning parameters
primary_theme: Communication-Aware Tuning for Large-Scale LLM Pretraining
